sources.description: Sunday at Soldier Field (12:00pm CST), the Chicago Bears welcome the New York Jets to the gridiron in a contest where both teams have key players injured and sidelined. The Jets walk in at 1–2 without Breece Hall (quad), their dynamic running back, and the Bears will walk out once again without Caleb Williams (hamstring) […]
